analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and metadata against the indexed model and selected T-041 detail. No concrete security regression is established within this scope. ProviderLoop+StartupPreload.swift:307-309 now queues recovery for memory-limited or unattempted candidates, guarded by cancellation, shutdown and preload-stop state. Existing advertised-model filtering, serialized no-eviction loading, slot-bound failed-self-test hash records and retirement refusal remain visible and unchanged. Integration must examine ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery: selection/advertisement revalidation, bounded retries, memory admission, failed-build refusal and add-on-hold fencing (A-018, T-059, TB-012), including cancellation when shutdown starts. Its implementation is not supplied here.
ProviderLoop+StartupShutdown.swift:61,78-96 replaces indefinite sequential unload waits with a 15-second per-slot bound and permits completion with retained slots and outstanding unload tasks. Endpoint stop, serving drain, App Attest worker stop, inflight cancellation and native MiMo owner drain precede this change. Integration must verify unloadModel/native retirement ownership and callers of shutdownBeforeRegistration: successful cleanup now does not prove all slots retired, so retained native work must remain isolated until actual process exit, including any subsequent serving window. Also verify cache reclamation at line 63 is safe while abandoned unloads continue (TB-007, T-028, T-029), and process termination remains authoritative for logout/token custody (A-008, T-053). Missing callers/native implementations do not establish an unsafe reuse or reclamation regression.
ProviderLoop+Testing.swift adds internal recovery override/wait seams at patch head lines 514-525; no external invocation surface is shown. No changed encryption, cache scope, attestation policy, billing or plaintext logging behavior was observed; unchanged controls and dependencies were not fully reviewed.
